profile:
COMPANY NAME: Roku
INDUSTRY: Consumer Electronics / Streaming Media
PRODUCT OR SERVICE: Roku offers streaming media players, sticks, and smart TV operating systems that allow users to access a wide variety of streaming services and live TV channels.
TARGET CUSTOMERS: Consumers and households looking to add streaming capabilities to their televisions or replace traditional cable/satellite TV services.
PRICING MODEL: Hardware sales (one-time purchase) and optional subscription services for premium channels.
KEY FEATURES: 
- Access to thousands of streaming apps and channels
- Live TV streaming options
- User-friendly interface and remote control
- Integration with major streaming platforms (Netflix, Hulu, Disney+, etc.)
- Support for multiple screen sizes and resolutions
UNIQUE SELLING POINTS: 
- Aggregates content from multiple providers into a single interface
- Affordable hardware options
- Wide compatibility with various TV brands
- Regular software updates and new feature releases
TONE & POSITIONING: Consumer-friendly, accessible, and focused on simplifying the streaming experience for a broad audience.
